prompts.object: Photorealistic special-education card atlas EXACT FIVE EQUAL WIDTH columns and TWO EQUAL HEIGHT rows (ten square cells, canvas aspect ratio 5:2). Will be cropped at 20%,40%,60%,80% width and 50% height. EVERY object entirely visible with 15% safe margin on each tile edge, no overlap/neighbor fragments. Matching top/bottom pairs SAME color, size, orientation and object baseline. No text, numbers, symbols, borders, arrows, glow or logos. Real-life recognizable objects. Pure white clean seamless backgrounds, only very soft ground shadow below subject. Teach WET versus DRY, same CLEAN objects and same color in each paired column. TOP ROW WET objects unmistakably visibly coated in clear water droplets (fabric visibly soaked with drops on surface and lower edge), BOTTOM ROW fully DRY matching clean objects, NO droplets NO damp patches. Col1 blue cotton washcloth neatly laid flat; col2 red child-size T-shirt laid flat complete sleeves/hem; col3 yellow kitchen sponge; col4 green rubber boot complete shaft and sole; col5 light brown wooden spoon complete handle and bowl. Water must be on the target itself; no floating disconnected droplets or splashes outside frame, no stains/mud/food. Dry cloth still blue and dry shirt still red, not white. Photo lightly from above so full shape visible. All edges clean and complete, material textures realistic. Do not use color alone as cue.
